fields.name: POSTED HERE

fields.name: DATES
fields.value: The Startup Draft begins in late January 2027 and each Annual Draft between January 20 and February 10. Both are announced at least 30 days ahead (Articles V, XIII and XIV).

fields.name: ON THE CLOCK
fields.value: Fantrax alerts each manager when it's their pick, so Discord doesn't repeat those alerts. Round results are posted in **📋│draft-results**.
